## Approvals Tab

The Approvals tab contains several system-specific options for configuring prior period adjustments (PPAs).

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

You can require that PPAs or edits above a threshold are approved before they are applied. This means that instead of an edit applying automatically after editing data, the edit would require approval by designated users with approval privileges.

</div>



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 626;height: 536;" />

The Approvals tab contains the following options:

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="PPA Options">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />PPA Options</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="PPA Options">

- **Drop-Down Menu**

> - **PPAs not Allowed** – PPAs are not allowed on closed data.
> - **Apply Immediate** – When you save an edit, the PPA is applied immediately without requiring approval. When this option is selected, the Allow Auto PPAs option must be checked to enable use of the [Create PPAs](../../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Calculations%20Tab.md#CreatePPAs) options in the Meter Editor.
> - **Approval Required** – Each PPA is stored in a holding bin until it is approved by one or more designated users belonging to a group. Once approved, the PPA is finalized and applied.
>
> > When this option is selected, the Allow Auto PPAs option is automatically set to "Yes". The [Create PPAs](../../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Calculations%20Tab.md#CreatePPAs) options in the Meter Editor must be checked to allow PPAs to be created for each meter.
> >
> > Approval groups are designated in the <a href="#EditApprovals" class="notelink">Edit Approvals</a> section.

- **Allow Auto PPAs** - Allow re-imports of data (if the [Create Revisions](../../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Imports%20Tab.md#CreateRevisions) option is enabled in Meter Editor), edits of source assignment data, imports of test reports, etc. to edit meter data and create corresponding PPAs, based on the [Create PPAs](../../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Calculations%20Tab.md#CreatePPAs) options in the Meter Editor.

  If this option is not enabled, closed data can only be edited within the Volume Editor or PPA Editor.

  This option is only active when the "Apply Immediate" option is selected.

- **Set Accounting Month To**
  - **Business Month** (default) - The first open month after the last closed month. If the last month closed is April and the current date is July 10, the PPA is accounted for in the business month of May (last month after close in April).
  - **Production Month** - The measurement month during which a gas or liquid product flowed.
    <div class="example">

    <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-ProdMonth">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

    In July, an edit is made to closed data for a flow that occurred in January. In this case, January is the production month; July is the accounting month.

    </div>
  - **Allow Edit** - Choose which month to have the PPA accounted for.

- **Show Total on GVS Report** - You can determine whether to show the accounted for information on the Meter Gas Volume Statement by checking or not checking this option.

- **Enable Daily PPA Accounting** - By default, PPA accounting information stored in the database only contains the net change of PPAs for the entire month regardless of what data is actually edited. When this option is enabled, daily PPA accounting information is also stored as PPAs are performed.

  The daily PPA accounting information is not displayed on any screen but is available in the database for custom exports as needed.

  <div class="example">

  <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-DailyPPA">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

  Editing an hour on the 1st, 5th, and 15th of the month with a change of 10 to the volume for each edit will generate a record for the month with a net change of 30. While this tracks the monthly change, it does not track each daily change within the month. With the "Enabled Daily PPA Accounting" option enabled, the information stored will reflect the daily PPA changes by generating three records, one for the 1st, 5th, and 15th, with each record showing a net change of 10.

  </div>

- **Account for Liquid PPAs in Business Month at Location Level** - When this option is enabled, if there is a PPA on a meter or a ticket, FLOWCAL determines which locations the meter or ticket feeds directly into. For each location, a reversal entry will be created for the amount of the PPA with the reverse sign. Another entry is created or accounted for in the current business month. The current business month is defined as follows:

  - If the first open month is the current calendar month, the entry will be created with today’s date.
  - If the first open month is a prior calendar month, then the entry will be created on the last day of that month.

  For PPA totals to be rolled up correctly, users must have flow data on the date where the PPA is to be accounted for. It is assumed that there is not more than one open month between closed months and the current month. This option is applicable to liquid meters only.

</div>

<span id="EditApprovals"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Edit Approvals">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Edit Approvals</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Edit Approvals">

When the PPA options are set to "Approval Required", you will use these options to designate one or more approval groups. Each drop-down box contains groups with Edit Approval privileges. Click the plus sign to add the selected group to approval group 1 through 3. Click the minus sign to remove groups that have been added previously.

If groups are only added to group 1, a PPA requires one level of approval. If groups are added to group 1 and group 2, two levels of approvals are required. If groups are added to groups 1, 2, and 3, three levels of approvals are required.

Approvals can be provided in any order (e.g., members from group 2 can provide approval before members of group 1), but at least one person from each set of groups must approve the PPA before it is applied.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-EditApprovals">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

In this system, a group called "Editors" has an approval limit of 500 mcf. Another group called "Supervisors" has an unlimited approval limit. If both are added to the first approval section, a single approval is needed for an edit, and a member from either group could provide that approval. If the PPA for a given month is 600 mcf (exceeding the Editors group limit of 500 mcf), users in the Editors group could not approve the edit, but a user from the Supervisors group could approve it.

</div>

</div>
